known_route_findings: The amendment says the preflight receipt contained a draft route table; it did not. These rows are new A1-R2 resolver bindings.
The pinned dolma3_pool tree contains Common Crawl assets but zero olmOCR assets despite the pinned card text; olmOCR is therefore routed through the primary Dolma 3 mix.
The Dolma 3 mix is upsampled, so stable document identity deduplication is mandatory before selection.
The 0019 web selector is a quality-order inference from official Dolma 3 construction documentation and remains labeled as such.
Mechanical card checks do not replace Mark's programme-level license review before P-B.
